complexity.explanation: Each tick inside the requestAnimationFrame render loop executes in constant O(1) time and space, updating the lineDashOffset scalar property and clearing the 300x300 pixel buffer.

executionTrace.memoryDetail: Overwrites previous raster buffer with opaque surface color #181B22 to prevent ghosting artifacts.
Registers a two-element dash pattern array [500, 500] representing drawn segment and gap length.
Updates phase shift scalar offset, progressively revealing the drawn stroke segment as offset decrements to 0.
Rasterizes circular arc pixels intersecting the active visible window of the dash pattern.
Schedules subsequent iteration callback on the browser compositor queue synchronized with display refresh.

pitfalls.title: Unbounded requestAnimationFrame Loop Leaks on Unmount
pitfalls.description: Failing to cancel the active animation frame callback when components unmount causes continuous CPU loop execution, battery drain, and memory leaks in SPA navigation.

pitfalls.title: Missing Canvas Frame Clearing Causes Stroke Smearing
pitfalls.description: Omitting clearRect or fillRect on each animation tick causes newly stroked segments to draw over stale pixel data, smearing and dirtying the display surface.

seniorInterviewTip: Production pipelines offload stroke dash to GPU fragment shaders using normalized arc length instead of CPU-driven canvas re-strokes. When SVG or Canvas path animation is required on the web, CSS stroke-dashoffset acceleration or WebGL instancing avoids main-thread JS overhead.
